hero.description: NexSift is a knowledge aggregator that gets straight to the point. It filters, verifies and contextualizes what matters across AI, cloud, development and tech careers, with every signal traceable to its official source.

latest.title: What deserves your attention now
latest.description: Not a news portal. A short selection of signals with enough context and a traceable source.

topics.title: Six areas, one radar
topics.description: Frequencies are the radar's coverage areas. Signals are the verified posts published within each frequency. Selection stays focused on signals with real technical or professional impact.

process.title: Curation before publication
process.description: AI helps research, organize and review. Published content must stay traceable to its sources.

trust.title: AI assisted. Sources visible.
trust.description: Each analysis gets straight to the point: what happened, what changed and why it matters. NexSift does not replace the original source; it points to the material that supports the content and separates facts from interpretation.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what NexSift collects and how data is handled, in line with the LGPD.
privacy.collectBody: NexSift uses PostHog to measure site usage with anonymous events, such as visited pages and source clicks. There are no accounts, logins, advertising cookies or third-party sharing. No personally identifying data is collected.
privacy.contentBody: Posts are produced with AI assistance from official public sources and point to those sources. Before making decisions, review the original material; errors can occur.
privacy.rightsBody: You may request access, correction or deletion of any data related to you at any time, through the contact email below.
privacy.updated: The current version of this policy is the one published on this page.

about.title: A technical filter, not another infinite feed
about.body: NexSift exists to reduce the cost of keeping up with technology. Instead of reproducing everything that gets published, it prioritizes signals with real impact for people who build software, work with cloud or follow the evolution of AI.
about.creatorTitle: Built by someone who lives the problem
about.creatorBody: NexSift was created by Tiago Castro, a fullstack and cloud developer. The motivation came from the cost of keeping up with technology: endless feeds, hype and little context. NexSift is the filter he wanted for himself: few signals, verifiable sources and direct context on what changes for people who build software.
